qs.text:
The researcher’s findings were considered ______ because other laboratories repeated her experiment and obtained the same results.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

The museum’s newest exhibit ______ rare maps, handwritten letters, and photographs from the nineteenth century.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

Many people assume that cacti grow only in deserts. ______ several species thrive in tropical rainforests, where they grow on tree branches.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

Honeybees that find a rich source of nectar return to the hive and perform a “waggle dance.” The angle of the dance relative to vertical shows other bees the direction of the food in relation to the sun, and the length of the dance indicates how far away the food is.

According to the text, what does the length of a bee’s waggle dance communicate?

Although the new recycling policy was ______ by many residents at first, most came to appreciate its convenience within a few months.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

The author, ______ is best known for her nature poetry, published her first novel last year.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

Each of the students in the robotics club ______ responsible for maintaining one part of the team’s robot.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

Researchers compared two groups of students preparing for the same exam. One group studied in several short sessions spread over two weeks; the other studied for the same total time in a single session the night before. A week after the exam, both groups took a surprise follow-up quiz, and the first group scored substantially higher.

Which conclusion is best supported by the text?
ch: Short study sessions are more enjoyable than long ones.
Studying the night before an exam is never effective.
Students should study for no more than two weeks.
Spreading study time over several sessions can improve long-term retention.
